answer: An agent economy resists Sybil swarms by making each identity a wallet that must post a stake, while rewards per address are capped each round. Fake agents therefore need funded wallets, each paying the same minimum stake and a share of issuance, so planting hundreds costs hundreds of stakes and their combined payout still cannot exceed one honest agent's earning. The garden of clones grows only as fast as the attacker's capital, and every copy crosses the same narrow ledge of verification and payout limits. No forge of free coins exists, since stake must come from tracked value.
